label: Motivation-Emotion system (global)
description: Superordinate node: the person's single valuation process whose two coupled readouts are motivation (action guidance) and emotion (state signaling)

label: Appraisal / valuation core
description: Evaluates stimuli against needs and goals, computing reward/punisher value; comprises primary and secondary appraisal

label: Motivation readout
description: Action-guidance readout: direction, intensity, and persistence of goal pursuit

label: Emotion readout
description: State readout: core affect, discrete emotion, expression, action tendency, subjective feeling, hedonic impact

label: Approach / reward channel
description: Positive-incentive (approach) channel; behavioral activation

label: Avoidance / punishment channel
description: Threat/punisher (avoidance) channel; behavioral inhibition; fearful salience

label: Action / behavior output
description: Instrumental, goal-directed and expressive behavior emitted by the system

label: Needs input layer
description: Interface to the Needs stratum (Batch F): need deficits and pressures energize and direct appraisal

label: Situation / environment layer
description: Interface to the Systems stratum (Batch H): situational stimuli are appraised; emotional expression is communicated outward

label: Personality layer
description: Interface to the Personality stratum (Batch D): traits bias appraisal thresholds and affective reactivity

label: Temperament layer
description: Interface to the Temperament stratum (Batch E): reactivity set-points and affective thresholds (BIS/BAS)

label: Psychopathology interface
description: Interface to the Disorder stratum (Batch A): dysregulated wanting, anhedonia, fearful salience, maladaptive attribution, and emotion dysregulation as risk pathways

label: Therapy / regulation interface
description: Interface to the Therapy stratum (Batch B): reappraisal, behavioral activation, and exposure operate on the regulation edges

label: Causal attribution
description: Locus, stability, and controllability ascriptions that set expectancy and generate outcome-specific emotions

label: Incentive salience ('wanting')
description: Dopaminergic attribution of motivational salience to reward cues; separable from liking and from learning

label: Emotion-motivation regulation
description: Modulation of the readouts at five points: situation selection, situation modification, attentional deployment, cognitive reappraisal, response modulation

label: Reinforcement learning / value updating
description: Reward-prediction learning and habit formation that revise appraised value; two-factor (stimulus-reinforcer) learning

label: Primary appraisal (goal relevance/congruence)
description: Whether and how a stimulus bears on active goals and needs

label: Secondary appraisal (coping/control)
description: Appraised control, coping potential, and accountability

label: Direction (goal selection)
description: Selection among competing goals; approach-avoidance orientation

label: Intensity (vigor / energization)
description: Effort and energization mobilized toward the goal

label: Persistence (volition)
description: Maintenance of goal pursuit over time and obstacles

label: Core affect (valence x arousal)
description: The two-dimensional feeling substrate underlying all emotion

label: Discrete emotion (categorical)
description: Categorical emotions (fear, anger, joy, sadness, disgust, etc.), basic or constructed

label: Expression / communication
description: Outward expressive signaling of emotional state (Emotion II readout)

label: Action tendency / readiness
description: Readiness to act in a relational mode (approach, flight, attack, rejection)

label: Subjective feeling / experience
description: Consciously experienced quality of the emotion (Emotion III readout)

label: Hedonic impact ('liking')
description: Pleasure/displeasure reaction to reward outcome; separable from wanting
